I need to pump the brakes here. At twelve, your body is still growing, and training for strength needs to be built around that — not like an adult program.

The best thing you can do right now is move a lot, play sports you like, eat well, and get good sleep. If you want to lift weights, talk to your parents first, and ideally train with a coach who knows how to work with young athletes. That's not me being cautious — it's just how it works at your age.

Your friends being bigger right now doesn't mean much. Some people grow earlier, some later. You've got time.
